== Publication history ==
The 2014 Set 1 preview supplies the original wording. The Players Committee blanked this title in December 2019 and published Imperial Enforcement as the unique replacement. The replacement retains the original rules wording.<ref>[https://res.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/2019/12/december2019errata.pdf#page=1 Players Committee December 2019 errata sheet, p. 1].</ref>
